messages.subject: RStan 2.6.0 install script fixed
messages.body_plain:
Hi all,

There is an incompatibility with RStan 2.6.0 and the new BH package (1.58.0) on CRAN. Ben fixed the install script and there shouldn't be issues installing RStan 2.6.0 now. If you have any problems, please reach out.

We're still working on the next release and we will have 2.7.0 available soon.

- Stan Development Team
